title: SHE'S NOT THE CHEATIN' KIND
lyrics_plain:
She's dressed to kill
in a dress he bought her
She wouldn't care
if he walked in and caught her
She's come to dance
a dance or two
And do no tellin' what
by the time the night is through
She found out
the hard way about him
She's out to find out
how she'll do without him
Her hands are shakin',
her hearts' poundin'
By the way she's drinkin'
his memory's drowning
She's not the cheatin' kind
She's been cheated one too many times
She's never fooled around
He's still lying,
she's through crying
She's not fooling now
